title: TS2Python wire frame (proto 2)
description: One shape for every point on every chart. There is no tick/bar split: TradeStation supplies the same reserved words whatever the chart is, and dropping some of them by chart type was the publisher deciding what a number meant.

proto.description: Wire protocol version. Exactly one is supported.

seq.description: Per-symbol monotonic sequence. Required on every frame; without it loss cannot be detected.

sid.description: Publisher session id. Changes on DLL restart, which is a reset rather than a gap.

ts.description: DLL receive-side wall clock, UTC epoch seconds. Latency measurement and the last-resort time source.

ts_str.description: EasyLanguage BarDateTime, yyyy-MM/dd-HH:mm:ss (24-hour), America/New_York wall clock. AUTHORITATIVE for bar_time: parse as ET, convert to UTC, store it -- SECONDS INCLUDED. Do NOT floor to the minute: BarDateTime carries real seconds (Date/Time do not), and flooring collapses a sub-minute chart's bars onto one bar_time, where the consumer's intra-bar buffer reads the second as an update of the first and drops it. It is the point's CLOSE time and lands that way -- no shift onto a left edge, no grid alignment. See semantics.md 1.3 and 2.1.

bar_type.description: EasyLanguage BarType, verbatim. TradeStation's own values: 0 tick, 1 minute, 2 daily, 3 weekly, 4 monthly, 5 point&figure, 8 kagi, 9 kase, 10 line break, 11 momentum, 12 range, 13 renko, 14 second, 15 renko custom, 16 renko mean. Nothing maps it to a timeframe name and no value is refused.

bar_interval.description: EasyLanguage BarInterval, verbatim. Its unit follows bar_type: minutes for BarType 1, seconds for BarType 14, prints for BarType 0. No combination is refused.

category.description: EasyLanguage Category, verbatim: 0 Future, 2 Stock, 3 Stock Option, 4 Index, ... The meaning of the five el_* words depends on it -- see semantics.md 3.4 and 3.5.

c.description: EasyLanguage Close. On a 1-tick series all four are the same print.

el_volume.description: EasyLanguage Volume, verbatim. NOT 'the volume' -- see semantics.md 3.4.

el_open_interest.description: EasyLanguage OpenInt, verbatim. Measured to return DownTicks on every intraday chart -- see semantics.md 3.4.

bid.description: EasyLanguage InsideBid, or null where the publisher had none. Sent on every point, bars included.

ask.description: EasyLanguage InsideAsk, or null where the publisher had none.
